programme.title: Our Big Blue Backyard
programme.desc: Just north of New Zealand's biggest city, tens of thousands of fish school meters from the beach in one of the world's first marine reserves. Inside the Goat Island Reserve giant snapper can live for eighty years and crayfish grow to weigh 8 kilos. Both feed on the thousands of sea urchins that graze the kelp forest, maintaining a delicately balanced ecosystem. Like many of the reserve's inhabitants, they entrust their larvae to the ocean currents - so how do they find their way back to the reef when they take on their adult form and settle down?

programme.title: Hannah Goes to Namibia
programme.desc: As soon as she arrives, conservationist Hannah Emde immerses herself in Namibia's wildlife. The first destination of her trip is the world-famous Naankuse Foundation near Windhoek

programme.title: Hannah Goes to Namibia
programme.desc: Hannah runs a health check on two female cheetahs with veterinarian Maaike. She then goes into the wilderness with Naankuse founder Marlice. Together they go in search of the elephant Apollo, which was resettled in the sanctuary. The former "problem" elephant now leads a peaceful life here.

programme.title: Sixteen Legs
programme.desc: Giant prehistoric spiders seek love in the dark. Neil Gaiman journeys into Australia's deepest caves in a real-world “Charlotte's Web” recounting 25 years' study of the first web-spinners. These animals outlasted the dinosaurs, survived the splitting of the continents and have endured the entirety of human civilisation. Award-winning cinematography takes viewers through Tasmania's World Heritage wilderness into an underworld few people have seen.

programme.title: Manatees on the Move
programme.desc: Manatees, sea cows, these gentle giants go by several names. They were once thought to be beautiful mermaids that could lure sailors to their deaths, though they probably won't win too many beauty contests. To retain their weight, manatees need to eat for 8 hours and consume 8% of their bodyweight every day. And keeping eating also means keeping moving! Thanks to their tolerance of human visitors, manatees have mates everywhere, working tirelessly to ensure they roam the world for generations to come.

programme.title: If There Was No Land On Earth
programme.desc: The third episode is a story about the rich cultural heritage and remarkable skill of the shipbuilders of Sulawesi told by an amazing local craftsman. We will watch as they construct and sail traditional wooden vessels that have been passed down through generations. We will follow the gripping story of the Carnatic, a British ship that wrecked on the coral reef in 1869, discover how the crew survived and how the treasure they carried was salvaged.

programme.title: If There Was No Land On Earth
programme.desc: Embark on an immersive journey through the heart of the Indo-Pacific as we explore the breathtaking coral reef ecosystem, home to an array of vibrant fish species and magnificent manta rays. Let's unearth the secrets of a prehistoric cave nestled within this underwater wonderland and marvel at the stunning beauty of the shoals of fish that dance around us. The vibrant colors and intricate details of this marine paradise offer a mesmerizing glimpse into the world beneath the waves that captivate with the majesty and wonder of the coral reef, as we witness nature at its most spectacular.

programme.title: If There Was No Land On Earth
programme.desc: A mesmerizing journey on the border of two amazing worlds - beyond the turquoise waters of Raja Ampat, a paradise of diverse coral gardens, multitudes of fascinating species of fish and towering barrel sponges and up on the land where the unique cultures and ways of life, as well as struggles and triumphs of the people who call this remote and stunning corner of the world home are shown.

programme.title: If There Was No Land On Earth
programme.desc: Discover the breathtaking beauty of the Wayag archipelago and its underwater wonders. From vibrant coral gardens to a diverse array of marine creatures, immerse yourself in the mesmerizing world beneath the surface. Discover how the beautiful pearls are made and meet the dedicated people behind the process. Witness the silky shark's grace and agility in its underwater habitat and learn about the bamboo shark's unique characteristics and behaviors.

programme.title: Wild Moments
programme.desc: As an animal filmmaker, one often deals with lots of strange old birds. No wonder, that so much can go wrong. After a long day of filming, a surprise awaits at the camp: Wolves have been looking for chocolate biscuits! Yet these are not the only things that can happen in the Arctic. Yann Sochaczewski is out and about in the magnificent Grand Canyon. On his raft on the Colorado River, he risks life and limb in doing so. In Australia, Thoralf Grospitz and Jens Westphalen play cat and mouse with an odd bird, that turns out to be a real entertainer. In the Serengeti, Reinhard Radke despairs of the many tourists who constantly walk in front of his lens. Wildlife filmmakers travel around the world for these very encounters. They bring nature into our living rooms, experience the beautiful, the saddest and the most poignant moments. And many funny ones.

programme.title: Wild Moments
programme.desc: When humans and wild animals live next door to one another, things can sometimes be a little hairy. Some organise themselves in impertinent gangs, others mutually cultivate their own friendships. In New Zealand, keas organise themselves into gangs and obviously have it in for all the rubber seals belonging to winter sports enthusiasts. Their motto: nibble all you can. In Australia, Klaus Weißmann and Rolf Sziringer struggle with a huge invasion. Thousands of flies have taken a liking to the two men. This causes frayed nerves. And in Zambia, Jens Westphalen and Thoralf Grospitz capture a veritable display of elephants with the camera. Every year, their fine noses lead them into a hotel garden - in which the fruits on the wild mango tree are ripe. But, there is a catch: To get to their picnic, they have to walk through the lobby. This is what happens when buildings are erected around even older premises.

programme.title: The Beavers are back
programme.desc: The return of the beavers is one of the greatest success stories of nature conservation in Germany. Hunted for a long time and almost exterminated, today more than 35.000 beavers live in Germany again – and the trend is rising. But how did this happen? One gets to see the mostly nocturnal animals only rarely. Klaus Weißmann has spent more than two years tracking down the shy beavers and documenting their spread in Germany. Which ways do they use? What dangers are they exposed to? Step by step, this film tells the exciting and sometimes odd success story of the likeable rodents.

programme.title: Alpine Whistleblowers
programme.sub-title: On the Playground of the Marmots
programme.desc: These peculiar and roughly rabbit-sized rodents enjoy great popularity at the Großglockner in the Austrian Alps. Before the last ice age, marmots used to live in the lowland of Tirol, but with the melting of the glaciers they were driven higher up into the mountains – a trend that will continue given the current climate change. Today, they simply feel too warm below 800 meters. In spring, as soon as the temperatures begin to rise, marmots leave their dens after a nearly six-month long hibernation. After eating their share and recovering from the long fast, losing up to a third of their body weight, the most important thing is founding a family. And that sometimes involves rather fierce territorial conflicts amongst the males. As long as there is snow covering the meadows, the marmots run a high risk being out – golden eagles are looking for prey. But the marmots have an efficient warning system set up: while the group is feeding, several sentinels are located around the meadow, warning the others by shrill whistling. At the start of summer, the young ones will appear and need to be extra careful.

programme.title: Survival of the Fittest in the Alps
programme.desc: The documentary shows the survival strategies of various animal species in the high mountains of the Alps in winter. Despite freezing temperatures and limited food supply, chamois, red deer and snow hares manage to survive the cold months. Latest research reveals the amazing abilities the animals have developed to adapt to the extreme conditions and also how climate change is altering the behaviour of the alpine inhabitants.

programme.title: Secret Life Of Deer
programme.desc: 30 million white-tailed deer live in the United States. They have begun to adapt themselves to living in a world of traffic, pets and backyards. In Cayuga Heights, New York, the suburb's residents are trying to get used to this exceptional living arrangement. The deer can be spotted daily from kitchen windows and porches. Life in the suburbs is deer heaven – large areas of grass, no predators and plenty of water means their population is on a steady rise. In this documentary, white-tailed deer are outfitted with special cameras to take the viewer into their world. 'Deercam' allows us to see them in a new light – not frozen in the headlights of a car or as shy residents of the woods, but as intelligent and affectionate family animals.

programme.title: Follow Your Cat
programme.desc: Follow us while we follow cats on their hunting grounds for mice and birds. Experience the double life of your domestic tiger... she will lead you on adventures that you never thought were possible. With a behavioural scientist that specializes in cats and modern technology we follow the cat on their wanderings into the wild. She maps their routes, unveils their secret favourite places, chronicles their territorial conquests, and shows us the entertaining habits of this enigmatic creature.

programme.title: Bosnia Herzegovina
programme.desc: Wild and unknown lies the still undiscovered natural paradise of Bosnia and Herzegovina in the heart of Europe. Rough mountains, dense forests and wild waterfalls characterize the picture of the untouched landscapes. Lynx, wolves and bears roam mountains and valleys. One of the last primeval forests in Europe is a retreat for many endangered animal species. Bosnia and Herzegovina is actually an undiscovered natural paradise in the middle of Europe.

programme.title: The Grand Hotel
programme.desc: The five friends help out at The Grand Hotel that Andrea's family just bought during what was supposed to be a quiet weekend until a hotel critic arrives unexpectedly. The girls are ready to do everything to make a great impression – but things don't quite go according to plan. Andrea, Stephanie, Olivia, Emma and Mia have come for breakfast at the fanciest hotel in town, now owned by Andrea's family. When Andrea's aunt has to leave town, the girls volunteer to run the hotel for the weekend with the help of quirky Grandma Jean. This is the perfect job for Stephanie's expert managerial skills but then the hotel suddenly fills to capacity with guests, including a hotel critic that can make or break the hotel's reputation! Now the girls find themselves in over their heads juggling reception, childcare, food prep and waitressing, a dog-walking service and a testy chef who quits on them in the middle of dinner. Unfortunately, much of this is their own fault. Can the girls save the Grand Hotel from themselves?

programme.title: Ninjaball Run
programme.desc: When the ninja learn that Darreth's Mojo Dojo is to be destroyed and Darreth doesn't have the money to save it, our heroes enter the annual NinjaBall Run to win its cash prize in order to save the dojo. As Lloyd continues to train and unlock his hidden powers, the Ninja learn land developers are going to destroy Darreth's Mojo Dojo unless Darreth can find the money to save it. The Ninja decide to enter their Ninja Tank into the annual NinjaBall Run cross-country rally to try to win its cash prize. Revisiting past characters who also enter the race, the high-speed derby will only grow more dangerous as Garmadon enters his Black Bounty, realizing this is the perfect chance to use his Mega-Weapon and rid the ninja. In the end, the Ninja will discover a few secrets within their Ninja Tank, allowing them to beat Garmadon's Bounty by a millisecond and saving Darreth's Dojo with their well-deserved cash prize. And as a final surprise, the Ninja steal back the Destiny's Bounty and make it their own once again.

programme.title: Child's Play
programme.desc: When the Ninja interrupt Lord Garmadon from using his Mega-Weapon to ‘turn back the clock' and bring to life the fossils of a monster, the Ninja are accidentally hit and turned into kids and are now forced to enlist Lloyd's help to battle the awakened monster. Tired of intense training, Lloyd yearns to play and enjoy his youth. The Ninja remind Lloyd that along with great power, comes great responsibility. When the Ninja interrupt Lord Garmadon from using his Mega-Weapon to ‘turn back the clock' and bring to life the fossils of a monster, the Ninja are accidentally hit and soon discover they've been turned into kids! Seeking Lloyd's help and relying on childhood antics, the five ninja kids must destroy the reawakened monster that's hunting them in the city. In the end, Lloyd makes the difficult decision and sacrifices his youth in order to save them from the beast, turning forward the clock and turning Lloyd into a young man. Sensei Wu fears now that since Lloyd is young man, the final battle of good versus evil approaches sooner than he had ever expected.

programme.title: The Surge
programme.desc: After a time of peace, the Ninja are called back into action. The spirit of the defeated Overlord has infected the electric grid of Ninjago and is using all available technology to exact his revenge on Lloyd. Nowhere is safe but fortunately, the Ninja have been given the powerful Techno Blades. But the only problem is that they have no idea how to use them. Time has passed since the Ultimate Battle, and while the Golden Ninja continues to watch over Ninjago, the other Ninja have become complacent as schoolteachers. When a mysterious invitation from genius Cyrus Borg brings them to the futuristic New Ninjago City, trouble surges when a digital virus of the Overlord takes over technology. The Golden Ninja makes a heroic entrance, only to find out his Golden Power supercharges the enemy. Sensei Wu stays behind so that the Ninja can escape with the only thing that can save Ninjago's future – Borg's Techno Weapons.

programme.title: The Art Of The Silent Fist
programme.desc: The Ninja go into hiding but an army of the Digtial Overlord's evil robotic Nindroids are hunting them wherever they go. Their only chance is to learn the secrets of the Techno blades and use them to cut all power to save Ninjao from this technological menace. The Ninja hide out at a safe place void of technology – Sensei Garmadon's Sanctuary. That night, Zane is visited by Borg's female robo-assistant, Pixal. She warns them that the Digital Overlord is after Lloyd's Golden Power in order to become flesh, but the Techno Blades can reboot the system and erase him for good. After a highly advanced army of Nindroids attacks the Sanctuary, Lloyd flees with his father into the wilderness of Ninjago, while the rest set off on a quest to turn off all power in Ninjago, so that they can erase the Digital Overlord once and for all.

programme.title: The Book Of Total Badness
programme.desc: The NEXO-Knights must fight Jestro's Monsters of Destruction which are attacking all over the Kingdom. But Merlok smells a trap…is he right? In a dark, destroyed part of the kingdom, Jestro arrives at the ruins of a HUGE castle. The Book of Monsters knows this place: the great evil wizard Monstrux lived here. The Book sniffs out some powerful magic in the ruins: “The Book of Destruction.” With this, The Book tells Jestro they can destroy the NEXO-Knights and then attack the King's Castle and cause massive destruction. Jestro creates destructive monsters and sends them all over the realm, so the Knights must separate and fight single combats all over the place. The Knights lose these battles (lesson: they have to work as a team!) And, just when the Knights are scattered across the Kingdom, Jestro attacks the King's Castle! It looks like all is lost. When Aaron, who has escaped, returns to see Jestro's attack, he realizes he must gather his fellow Knights. Merlok says it's very dangerous, but Aaron says he must take the risk to gather the Knights and save Knighton.

programme.title: The Might And The Magic
programme.desc: Aaron races across the kingdom to gather the NEXO-Knights as Jestro and his Destructive Monsters attack the King's Castle. The Knights must get back to the capitol in time, or Jestro will rule the kingdom! Jestro, while still attacking the King's Castle, has second thoughts until the Book of Monsters orders the mad jester to feed him another magic book he's found (and has been saving.) It's the powerful “Book of Revenge!” Now, combining the powers of Revenge and Destruction, Jestro and his monsters will get their vengeance on King Halbert and the Kingdom of Knighton. Jestro and his monsters lay siege…will they destroy the castle?! Meanwhile, Aaron races across the Kingdom gathering the NEXO-Knights one at a time. As each Knight rejoins the group, they become a more and more powerful team. They even get Robin to join them as the Black Knight in his repaired power suit. Our Knights arrive, finally regrouped, fight off Jestro, save the castle and the King. It's a glorious victory! The King is so pleased after seeing how the brave NEXO-Knights saved his kingdom, he allows Macy to join them as an official NEXO-Knight.

programme.title: Back To School
programme.desc: When the NEXO-Knights are sloppy in a fight with Jestro, Merlok 2.0 sends them back to the Knights' Academy. Not only for a brush-up but to find out what Jestro is after in its hallowed halls. As they Knights battle Jestro – in a somewhat haphazard and lazy way – they discuss the fact that Jestro never wins and that they're always getting over on him. Despite defeating the jerky Jester and his evil Book, Merlok 2.0 discovers that something about the attack on the village is tied to the Knights' Academy. It looks like that's where they'll strike next. It wouldn't hurt for the Knights to go “back to school” to watch for Jestro and for some refresher training. Merlok is sure Jestro wants something at the Academy, but he doesn't know what it is. The Knights are very much “fish out of water” at the academy, even with the “cool kids” – Robin and Ava – showing them around. The next generation of Knights is being taught to integrate the NEXO-Magic of Merlok into their fighting techniques and these kids are good (so good, they initially kick the lazy, know-it-all Knight's butts!) Their old principal, the ever-ornery Headmaster Brickland, sets them straight: they're all still slackers, and they better get their acts together (especially Lance!) The Knights take shifts as “library helpers” much to the delight of the old squirebot librarian, MARGE. They're convinced Jestro is after a book…isn't he always after a book? When Jestro attacks, the Knights help organize the students and there's a big fight in the Academy Library versus Jestro and his Monsters. They drive Jestro off without letting him steal any books! Victory! But as Jestro leaves, we see him holding what the Book of Monsters really wanted: a snow globe with a castle in it that was sitting on the librarian's desk. In the Lava Lands, Jestro throws the snow globe into a volcano and it frees the massive Castle of Monstrux from its snowy magic prison

programme.title: Greed Is Good?
programme.desc: When Jestro uses the Book of Greed to rob Auremville of its riches, he also gets Lance's parents as prisoners and these demanding rich folks are too much for even monsters to handle. Jestro's not sure what to do with his new castle in the Lava Lands. “Every castle needs a big chamber filled with treasure” says the Book of Monsters so they've got to go out looting! The BOM convinces Jestro to call forth GENERAL MAGMAR, and Jestro appoints him as “general manager” of “castle operations,” much to Magmar's dismay. Meanwhile, Jestro and the BOM find the BOOK OF GREED. This will allow them to make greedy, rapacious monsters that will bring them all the treasure they want to fill their castle! They'll head to the richest town in the realm – AUREMVILLE! Meanwhile, in Auremville, the NEXO-Knights arrive for a huge “Gold is Good” ball at Lance's house. When the Monsters finally arrive in Auremville, a battle breaks out and the greedy monsters make off with everything…including Lance's parents, Goldie and Cuthbert Richmond who are clad in the finest golden garments and so look valuable! Lance will now be forced to live…poor. The Knights have to get his parents back. Meanwhile, his parents – Cuthbert and Goldie Richmond –think their imprisonment in Jestro's gold-filled castle is a “spa holiday” with the worst service. They order Magmar and the monsters around like servants and drive them all crazy. The Knights pile into the Fortrex and head for the Lava Lands, formulating a plan along the way to free Lance's parents. In a village half-way to Jestro's Castle, the Knights run into…Jestro and his monsters headed the other way with Lance's parents and all the gold they've stolen. There's a big fight, until they realize they might have the same goal and decide to deal. The BOM wants to give them back all the gold and Lance's parents. Lance says “No deal.” “We'll take the gold, you can keep my parents.” It's a weird and comical stand-off. Finally, Clay convinces Lance he has to take his parents back even if they don't always get along (and, it's the only way to get the gold back.)

programme.title: Scary Story About Spooky Stories

programme.title: Soul Freezing Tale Of Grim Forest And Tiny Timid Bug
programme.desc: All children are afraid of the dark. Masha was afraid of it too and had to sit with a torch all night long! But once upon a time she came up with the tale about a tiny bug, which lived in the woods and was so afraid of the dark, that every rustle made its heart tremble! The bug suffered a lot until he realized that all tiny things you see in the dark just seem to be frightful and fear makes no sense at all!

programme.title: Terrible Truth About Those Who Are Afraid To Be Little
programme.desc: Everyone think that it's so scary to be little as there are so many things are not accessible for you! But in reality there is no difference how little you are if there is someone who cares for you and someone you care about…

programme.title: Gloomy Story About The Darkest Dreams
programme.desc: All children are keen on computer games! Everyone likes to shoot a couple of monsters before going to sleep. Tolik also liked to play shooters until the monsters attack him in reality in order to commit the revenge! Or…was it just a dream? Let's see...

programme.title: Sinister Saga Of A Sick Tummy And A Girl Who Was Afraid Of Doctors
programme.desc: Masha narrates a terrific story about one little girl who was afraid of doctors. And once upon a time she experienced one fantastic story…she decided to cook dinner for her dolls. She took some clay and made “meat balls” with “semolina porridge”. As the meal seemed tasty, Sima decided to eat a bit of her dinner too… And so she lies in her bad and feels a horrible stomachache. Nobody knows how long she would need to suffer, but when she woke up…she realized herself in hospital…near the real snow queen… who explained that medical treatment is not scary at all…though some other things are very fearsome! Oh yeah!

programme.title: Bloodcurdling Saga About Joyful Event
programme.desc: Everyone think that it's so scary to be little as there are so many things are not accessible for you! But in reality there is no difference how little you are if there is someone who cares for you and someone you care about…

programme.title: Grim Parable About Superstitious Girl
programme.desc: Some people happen to believe in all sorts of omens like black cats, wearing clothes inside out, prophetic dreams… Poor girl Lucy believed in that kind of stuff so much that was even afraid to go outside to play with her friends. And how could you go out if you were born in the year of Purple rabbit that promises…no matter what… You'll see…

programme.title: Terrifying True Story About Monsters And Those Who Fear Them
programme.desc: Are you afraid of monsters? Sure you are! Let me tell you a scary story about a boy who experienced a real fear…This story happened on an abandoned tractor factory. The boy lost a scoop from his toy-tractor and decided to look for it at the factory. So he goes up the stairs and sees a large female monster, who was about to paint her lips with a roller! As he kept walking he noticed more monsters playing domino! The boy was very terrified and about to cry, when he learnt that it was just a movie set and all the monsters were not real! They were just actors…Finally the boy realized that all the monsters from the books and movies are not real at all! But if want to see a real monster- watch a fly under a microscope!

programme.title: The Wolf and the Fox
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: The Wolf and the Seven Young Kids
programme.desc: This educative tale teaches us that caution should never be dismissed. Mother-Goat goes to pick up cabbage, leaving her seven kids alone at home. Hungry Wolf tries to get into the house imitating mother Goat's voice to fool the little yeanlings. He manages to deceive six kids, but the seventh, the smallest one, manages to hide in the oven. The Wolf tries to get into the house through the chimney, but here comes Mother-Goat and finds her seventh kid. She melts the stove, and the Wolf rushes into the forest with his tail burnt. The other six kids come back home and finally the family reunites.

programme.title: The Fox and the Rolling Pin
programme.desc: This is the story about the Fox, the Cat and the Rooster. The sneaky Fox wanted to fool the Cat in order to eat the Rooster and get a rolling-pin. No matter how the Fox tried to butter up the Cat, he denied hand over the Rooster to the Fox. To teach her a lesson, the Cat got into a bag himself and when the Fox opened it in order to eat the Rooster, the Cat jumped out of it and frightened her. The point of the story is that “if you are well off you don't seek better”.

programme.title: Go I Know Not Whither
programme.desc: Once upon a time there was a king. He was very cranky and foolish. One day he wished to taste an exotic fowl and sent Yegor the huntsman to the deep forest. In the forest, Yegor met a starling, which turned into a beautiful girl. The Tsar saw Yegor to have successfully completed his task and also got the beautiful wife. He started to envy Yegor. The Tsar decided to send Yegor over distant seas to bring do not know what. Despite Tsar's insidious plan, Yegor has successfully returned back home and even taught the king an important lesson not to envy other people.

programme.title: The Frog Princess
programme.desc: There lived a Tsar with his three sons. The oldest son married on nobleman's daughter, the second one married the merchant's daughter, while the youngest son - on the Frog. She was not pretty, but happened to be the Frog Princess who turned into a beautiful girl. This story teaches us to take care of your pets. programme.title: Har Har Bhakti
programme.desc: Listen to Har Har Bhakti Devotional songs and start your day with praise of gods and goddesses. These songs are composed to inspire reverence, devotion, and connection with the divine.

programme.title: Paapnaashini Ganga
programme.desc: Paapnaashini Ganga Is A Mythological Show Based On The Life Of Goddess Ganga. The Show Takes The Viewers On The Journey Of Birth And Life Of Ganga. The Reason Behind Ganga'S Birth Was To Destruct Evil Entities. The Powers Of Adishakti Made Mainavati Give Birth To A Female Child Who Became Known As Ganga. Devatas Considered Ganga'S Purity As A Weapon Which Could Destroy Evil Asuras. As A Humble & Virtuous Woman, Ganga'S Entire Life Was Full Of Hardships, Which She Led Washing Away The Sins Of All Of Humanity Without Any Discrimination. Ganga Had Sacrificed All Her Desires On The Altar Of Dharma And Led A Divine Life Full Of Welfare Of Humanity. The Show Is Visually Appealing With Strong Vfx Which Will Enhance The Viewers Experience.

programme.title: Yam Kisi Se Kam Nahin
programme.desc: A misfit, a God, a husband, and a breadwinner, Yamraj is a common man with a fancy job title. He tries his best to give his family what they need and manages to make a mess of everything in the bargain. Lovable and goofy, this God of Death is anything but grim. Join our hardworking but hen-pecked Yamraj, his beloved buffalo and his motely family and friends in a slice-of-life sitcom to find out how the cookie really crumbles!

programme.title: Dharmakshetra
programme.desc: As The Great War Of Mahabharata Is Over, Kurukshetra Lies Barren In Its Great Warriors And King. The Thin Line Between Fair And Unfair, Deceit And Loyalty, Betrayal And Duty, Has Never Been Questioned. Dharmakshetra Resurfaces These Buried Questions And Allows The Legendary Characters Of This Tale An Opportunity To Tell Their Side Of The Story For The Very First Time. In A Post-Apocalyptic Trial, Held In Maharaj Chitragupta'S Court, The Seeming Villains ‘Kauravas' Are Allowed To Accuse The So Called Heroes ‘Pandavas' And Vice Versa, In An Attempt To Justify Their Actions. On A Primary Level, Dharamkshetra Attempts To Ask Some Key Questions About The Nature Of Humanity, While At The Same Time, It Puts Together The Forgotten Pieces Of The Story We Thought We Knew.

programme.title: Laal Banarasi
programme.desc: The story highlights the exploitation happening with the ‘Bunkars' in Banaras, whose craft is appreciated all around the world, but they are paid peanuts by the traders. Amidst this, blooms a love story between the two opposites - Gauri, a bunkar and Garv, a trader. The story is of Gauri who belongs to the bunkar community facing series of incidents which destroys her family and swears to bring about a change in their life and stop the exploitation by directly trading the sarees. This becomes a battle with traders creating hurdles in her life but she is unstoppable.

programme.title: Humkadam
programme.desc: Humkadam is a first of its kind show on Indian television that presents the complicated dynamics of ‘Saas' and ‘Bahu' in a clutter breaking manner. It tells the story of Tara and Shanti who are two diametrically opposite personalities, stuck in unprecedented situations. Just when they thought life had come to a full stop, is where they had to put their differences aside and start a new journey. Will they become each other's Humkadam to face all the adversities together?

programme.title: Dahej Daasi
programme.desc: This story is about a 19yr old girl named Chunari, who dreams of marriage and a happy family. However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.title: Bhabhi Ke Pyare Pritam Hamare
programme.desc: Bhabhi Ke Pyare Pritam Humaare Is A Light-Hearted Celebrity Chat Show Hosted By One Of India'S Most Famous Rj– Pritam Singh. In Each Episode, He Will Welcome Top Female Celebrities From The Entertainment Industry Who Have Played The Roles Of Bhabhi'S & Bahu'S On-Screen, Adding A Pinch Of Glamour To The Show. These Female Celebrities Will Talk About Their Real-World, Tell Their Untold Stories And Reveal How They Live Off-Camera. What'S More? The Episodes Of This Chat Show Will Have An Enthralling Line-Up Of Gag Artists, Activities/Games & Comedy Segments, Along With The Barrel Of Laughs – Pritam.

programme.title: Bablu Dablu Sunsational Summer
programme.desc: Bablu Dablu: Sunsational Summer is the latest installment in the rip roaring adventures following Briar and Bramble in their hilarious quest to stop Logger Vick's tree cutting antics. These summer episodes take our favorite characters on all new adventures through underwater chases, surviving the great outdoors, meeting new monsters, and many more exciting hijinx. The bear brothers and all of their friends unite again to save their home and teach Vick and all of us the importance of working together to protect our forest.

programme.title: Armor Monster
programme.desc: One day, 12-year-old Zachary once again met the subway "0" which her mother took nine years ago, and the appearance of the subway seems to have some connection with the necklace left by her mother. In order to find her mother, Zachary stepped on the magic subway without hesitation! When the train arrived at the station, Zachary found that he had come to a magical world of elves. He also met the elf Rooney chased by hunters. In order to protect the Rooney, they fled to the underground city. Here, Zachary meets Scarlett, a red haired girl, and Zachary accidently becomes the Rooney and is regarded as a half-face hunter who is under searched with big bonus in the underground city. In order to leave the underground city to find his mother, Zachary has to agree to fight with the old wizard, the King of the underground city. Under Scarlett's training, Zachary grew up fast. In the battle, his determination to protect the Rooney inspired the strength in the necklace and defeated the old wizard. And just when the angry wizard decided to show his real strength, the real half hunter came to the rescue. The real half hunter even had the same necklace. The unexpected encounter of the two necklaces triggered the emergence of spirits and demons which are eager for energy. In order to protect the underground city from being ravage, the half-face hunter left the underground city with Zachary and his friends. They used their tactics to temporarily eliminate the demons in the stone forest near the beast forest, and they entered the beast forest to avoid refuge.

programme.title: Bablu Dablu Monster plan

But first, Vector needs to collect these skills. He comes up with a power absorbing gadget, which he often disguises, in order to trap and steal abilities from the innocent animals. Vick, Briar and Bramble, along with other animal friends, must stand up against this “monster plan” of Vector's. It's going to be a fierce fight between wild animals and poaching villains.

programme.title: Armor Monster
programme.desc: One day, 12-year-old Zachary once again met the subway "0" which her mother took nine years ago, and the appearance of the subway seems to have some connection with the necklace left by her mother. In order to find her mother, Zachary stepped on the magic subway without hesitation! When the train arrived at the station, Zachary found that he had come to a magical world of elves. He also met the elf Rooney chased by hunters. In order to protect the Rooney, they fled to the underground city. Here, Zachary meets Scarlett, a red haired girl, and Zachary accidently becomes the Rooney and is regarded as a half-face hunter who is under searched with big bonus in the underground city. In order to leave the underground city to find his mother, Zachary has to agree to fight with the old wizard, the King of the underground city. Under Scarlett's training, Zachary grew up fast. In the battle, his determination to protect the Rooney inspired the strength in the necklace and defeated the old wizard. And just when the angry wizard decided to show his real strength, the real half hunter came to the rescue. The real half hunter even had the same necklace. The unexpected encounter of the two necklaces triggered the emergence of spirits and demons which are eager for energy. In order to protect the underground city from being ravage, the half-face hunter left the underground city with Zachary and his friends. They used their tactics to temporarily eliminate the demons in the stone forest near the beast forest, and they entered the beast forest to avoid refuge.

programme.title: Mid
programme.desc: Veteran actor, Naseeruddin Shah, explores the many untold stories of Indian cricket. He recalls the history of the game match highlights. Sportsmanship, stadiums, hits and misses, and many more. In his unique narrative style, Naseeruddin Shah brings alive the humorous side of the game, along with undocumented anecdotes and quirky trivia. The show also features many personalities who narrate cricketing experiences and stories including Shashi Tharoor, Narl Contractor, Bishan Singh Bedi and Charu Sharma amongst others

programme.title: Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: Regiment Diaries
programme.desc: The Indian Army is an emotion – a living chronicle of events, that we have the luxury to forget because they remember. The army itself is a family of several regiments, each of which has its own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army unlike any told before. Told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors, it tells timeless tales that warm the heart, moisten the eye, and leave you in awe of the bravest children of India.

programme.title: Kahi Suni
programme.desc: In a land steeped in mysticism, spirituality, and religion, the imagination of the followers has much room to flourish. Stories abound – some based on truth and some only on fractions of the truth. Nevertheless, these stories have enchanted their listeners for eons. Kahi Suni packs away our skepticism and takes us on a ride through the legendary tales of India. Each destination covered in the episodes has been the birthplace of a legend and each legend has given rise to the recognition of that location. Following our host from north to south and east to west, we journey through the land of myths of legends uncovering the origins of evIery story.

programme.title: The Way Back Home

programme.title: Safarnama

In Safarnama, we are up for a soulfulfilling journey with Ankit Siwach that is to begin in Mumbai and cease at Ladakh. This journey is to witness numerous unseen moments and unfelt experiences via a thrilling, adventurous route. It isn't just about navigating roads using GPS but more of digging deeper into the beauty of India to understand life better.

programme.desc: Charming host Chef Michael Bonacini explores the mountainous region of Basilicata with a feast fit for any celebration. Beginning with an antipasto that caters to the region's southern heat, Michael stuffs crunchy sweet peppers with ripe tomatoes, savoury anchovies, and fresh oregano. Moving on to the primo, Michael cooks up a creamy Vermicelli Frittata. Using leftover pasta, he combines eggs with cheese, anchovies, and chili flakes for extra flavour to make a classic Basilicata dish. programme.title: The Mercedes EQS SUV Electric Art Line Driving Video
programme.desc: With the luxury saloon EQS and the sporty executive saloon EQE, Mercedes-Benz has entered a new, all-electric era in the upper market segments as well. The EQS SUV, the third model series with this architecture developed for electric vehicles, will soon follow. The SUV offers plenty of space, comfort and connectivity for up to seven passengers in its avant-garde, luxurious interior. Thanks to powerful electric motors, responsive 4MATIC all-wheel drive and an intelligent OFFROAD driving mode, the EQS SUV is also capable of tackling light terrain with ease. The new EQS SUV shares the long wheelbase (3210 millimetres) with the EQS Saloon, but is over 20 centimetres higher. The dimensions in detail: 5125/1959/1718 millimetres (length/width/height). The interior dimensions benefit from these generous SUV dimensions and from the advantages of the purpose design tailored to the electric platform. The second row of seats can be electrically adjusted as standard. Up to four golf bags fit in the boot. A third row of seats with two additional individual seats and extensive comfort features for all passengers is available as an option.

programme.title: Colour change with the power of thought
programme.sub-title: The BMW iX Flow meets neuro-technology - Colour change with the power of thought - The BMW iX Flow meets neuro-technology
programme.desc: The Munich-based startup brainboost used the new and improved colour-changing effect in a one-off collaboration with the BMW Group at rad°hub aimed at raising awareness of mental health. With the help of brainboost, the BMW iX Flow was connected directly to the brain of the rad°hub delegates using an electroencephalograph (EEG), which records the brain's electrical activity. “The colour patterns of the BMW iX Flow react to brain activity and reflect the level of activity,” explains brainboost CEO Philipp Heiler. “Once the brain is at rest, the changes of patterns on the iX Flow also become calmer and more rhythmical.” A special animation was activated if delegates managed to maintain this state for several seconds. Thus, the participants were able to gradually calm and relax their brains under the guidance of the brainboost experts and with the help of neurofeedback via the iX Flow. This matures the knowledge of which strategies work best to specifically shut down one's own brain activity for relaxation, e.g. in everyday working life.

Zero to 100 km/h takes just 3.3 seconds (911 Carrera 4 GTS: Fuel consumption combined (NEDC) 10.5 – 9.7 l/100 km, Fuel consumption combined (WLTP) 11.4 – 10.6 l/100 km, CO₂ emissions combined (NEDC) 240 – 222 g/km, CO₂ emissions combined (WLTP) 259 – 240 g/km) in the 911 Carrera 4 GTS Coupé with the eight-speed Porsche dual-clutch transmission (PDK): three tenths faster than its predecessor. programme.title: From concept vehicle to full-production ID
programme.sub-title: From concept vehicle to full-production ID. Buzz - How was the electric Microbus created
programme.desc: The new model line's assistance systems perfect ease of driving and safety. Included as standard in the ID. Buzz and ID. Buzz Cargo is the ‘Car2X' local warning system, which utilises signals from other vehicles and the transport infrastructure to spot hazards in real time. Also included as standard: the ‘Front Assist' emergency braking function and, in the MPV, the ‘Lane Assist' lane-keeping assistant. With new software, new assistance functions are also making their way into the ID. family. Available as an option is ‘Travel Assist with swarm data', which facilitates partially automated driving across the entire speed range and, for the first time, assisted lane-changing on the motorway. Also new: the ‘Memory Function' for automated parking on a previously saved route.

programme.title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Product Highlights_en
programme.sub-title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Design Reveal Film
programme.desc: The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland. The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.

programme.title: Hispano Suiza showcases its history in the Peralada Castle Museum
programme.desc: The history of Hispano Suiza is showcased, for the very first time, in the Peralada Castle Museum (Girona, Spain) where visitors will be able to contemplate the past and present of the legendary car brand founded in 1904 by Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt. The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.

programme.title: TechDay Digital Light
programme.sub-title: Digital Future Lighting - TechDay Digital Light - Digital Future Lighting
programme.desc: Safety and customer satisfaction come first at Audi. They are part and parcel of the success of the company with the four rings. In that context, light technology is steadily growing more important and creating a wider range of possibilities and perspectives, from added safety for the driver, to external communication and individualization. Systematic light digitization is making all of this possible. It is particularly visible in the new Audi A8: the forward-looking Digital Matrix LED headlights and digital OLED rear lights raise the customer experience to a whole new level: for the first time in any Audi model, light is completely digitized. The car can be individualized even further through its digital OLED rear lights. The Digital Matrix LED headlights also include three new functions: advanced traffic information, a lane light with direction indicator lights on highways, and an orientation light on country roads. These features not only demonstrate Audi's “Vorsprung durch Technik,” they also add value.

programme.desc: The sixth generation Opel/Vauxhall Astra and third generation Peugeot 308 are both based on the Stellantis EMP2 platform and, unsurprisingly, score very similarly across all four areas of assessment. programme.title: Allonsanfan
programme.desc: 1816. Nell`Europa della Restaurazione, Fulvio Imbriani, un prigioniero politico aristocratico, ex giacobino ed ex ufficiale napoleonico, esce dal carcere e fa ritorno alla proprietà di famiglia. I suoi ex compagni di lotta fanno di tutto per coinvolgerlo nuovamente in azioni rivoluzionarie, ma lui è riluttante e sfiduciato. Finché si butta a capofitto in una rovinosa spedizione al Sud...

programme.title: Una giornata particolare
programme.desc: 6 maggio 1938. La Roma fascista è in festa per l`arrivo del Fuhrer in visita dal Duce. In un angolo di Roma più lontano dai fasti, in un edificio popolare, Antonietta, casalinga madre di sei figli, cresciuta nel culto del Duce, incontra casualmente per la prima volta il suo vicino di casa, Gabriele, ex annunciatore radiofonico omosessuale e prossimo al confino. Dopo la diffidenza iniziale, il loro rapporto si trasforma in affetto e comprensione...

programme.title: Into the Wild
programme.desc: La storia (vera) di Chris McCandless, un giovane americano che dopo essersi laureato con il massimo dei voti, lasciò tutto - casa, famiglia e amici - per avventurarsi senza soldi e risorse in un più che improvvisato viaggio attraverso gli Stati Uniti, finendo la sua personale e francescana odissea nel selvaggio Alaska, in un autobus abbandonato, condannato a sopravvivere con niente.

programme.title: The Way Ahead
programme.desc: Dramma sulla Seconda Guerra Mondiale che segue un gruppo di reclute britanniche, a partire dal loro rigoroso addestramento di base e termina con il loro dispiegamento in Nord Africa.

programme.title: I segreti di Brokeback Mountain
programme.desc: Due cowboy, Ennis e Jack, si incontrano su Brokeback Mountain e vivono un amore segreto che segnerà le loro vite per sempre, tra passioni soffocate e il peso delle convenzioni sociali.

programme.title: Vikings
programme.desc: 700 dc. I Franchi stanno provando a conquistare l'Europa. L'esercito di Carlo Martello uccide il re dei frisoni e getta in mare suo figlio Redbaldo. Sopravvissuto, farà ritorno con un'armata vichinga invincibile.

programme.title: Little big soldier
programme.desc: Un soldato della dinastia Liang si risveglia sul campo di battaglia dopo essersi finto morto. L'unico altro sopravvissuto è un giovane generale di Wei che decide di rapire non sapendo che è l'erede al trono e suo fratello lo cerca per ucciderlo!

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes
programme.desc: Un professore di archeologia, Moriarty, per impossessarsi di antichi pezzi provenienti da scavi fatti in Egitto, organizza una banda criminale che si macchia dei più efferati delitti. Ma tutte le sue mosse sono scoperte da Sherlock Holmes.

programme.title: I Racconti Del Cuscino
programme.desc: Nagiko, cresciuta dal padre nel culto di una tradizione che vede il corpo femminile come fonte d'ispirazione, comincia a praticare con i suoi amanti la scrittura sul corpo. Attraverso quest'ultima cercherà vendetta nei confronti di un perverso editore.

programme.title: The Ouija House
programme.desc: Laurie è una giovane studentessa appassionata di paranormale e che studia demonologia. Inzia per lei e i suoi amici un gioco letale che li condurrà a lottare contro una forza maligna

programme.title: The Canyons
programme.desc: Christian è un ventenne ricco, prepotente e manipolatore. La fidanzata Tara è, invece, una ex modella che pur di stare con Christian calpesta propria dignità. Le loro vite saranno cambiate da un incontro sessuale che li condurrà in un percorso di violenza, inganni e paranoia.

programme.title: Halloween The Beginning
programme.desc: Il feroce assassino Michael Meyers viene rilasciato dall'istituto psichiatrico in cui è stato rinchiuso per 17 anni e si scatena alla ricerca della sorella minore. Questo significa solo una cosa: nessuno è al sicuro!

programme.title: La città verrà distrutta all'alba
programme.desc: Immaginate di vivere in una piccola città dove tutto è sicuro e felice... finché improvvisamente non lo è più. In un terrificante racconto del "Sogno Americano" andato terribilmente storto, quattro abitanti di Ogden Marsh, IA, si ritrovano intrappolati nella loro città natale.

programme.title: Puoi baciare la damigella
programme.desc: Scarlett è un'influencer affermata di New York con una passione per la pasticceria. La ragazza, però, dovrà lasciare per breve tempo il suo nuovo impiego per prendere parte al matrimonio di sua sorella, da organizzare all'interno della loro vecchia casa, ora di proprietà del suo ex fidanzato Liam.

programme.title: Un matrimonio da ricordare
programme.desc: In contrapposizione per via di un progetto di sviluppo, Olivia e Brian sono sorpresi dallo scoprire di essere la damigella d'onore e il testimone dello stesso matrimonio. Dovranno mettere da parte i loro dissapori per salvare le nozze dei loro migliori amici, scoprendo di avere in comune molto più di quanto credevano.

programme.title: Un matrimonio su misura
programme.desc: Darcy, una talentuosa organizzatrice di eventi, torna nella città natale per organizzare il matrimonio di sua madre. Ha problemi ad accettare il futuro patrigno, e Kyle, l'affascinante chef che Darcy ritiene inadeguato per l'evento. Quando sorgeranno delle complicazioni sia personali sia professionali, Kyle si aiutarla a portare a termine il grande giorno e a trovare l'amore che stava cercando.

programme.title: Un matrimonio da salvare
programme.desc: Billie è la proprietaria di una società di donazioni di matrimoni, ma quando i clienti Max e Jess annullano il matrimonio, il fratello di Max, Charlie, non si fermerà davanti a nulla per tenerli insieme. Billie e Charlie dovranno mettere da parte le loro divergenze per aiutare la coppia a sposarsi una volta per tutte, e forse è ora che Billie organizzi il suo matrimonio...

programme.title: Shriver
programme.desc: Un tuttofare vive e lavora a New York City dove viene scambiato per uno scrittore famoso e viene portato in un'università. Qui dovrà tenere il discorso di apertura per salvare il festival letterario dell'istituto.

programme.title: Le mamme della sposa
programme.desc: Jenna si sta per sposare, sua madre è felicissima finché Jenna annuncia che vuole trovare la sua madre biologica.

programme.title: Love, Bubbles and Crystal Cove
programme.desc: Skye si sta preparando per un altro anno di grande successo della sua attività, Lather and Luxury, quando il suo amore d'infanzia Gavin arriva in città per aiutarla a migliorare il suo modello di business. Lei inizialmente rifiuta e...scoppiano scintille.

programme.title: Ridatemi mia figlia
programme.desc: Dopo la scomparsa della figlia a seguito del successo dell'apertura del suo ristorante, Eve decide di prendere in mano la situazione e scoprire chi c'è dietro al rapimento.

programme.title: Innamorarsi a Whitbrooke
programme.desc: Ad una project manager viene offerta l'opportunità di trasferirsi a Londra. Ma quando torna nella sua città natale ed incontra l'uomo perfetto, la sua passione de il suo talento per la pittura si riaccendono, dandole una nuova visione della vita e dell'amore.

programme.title: La melodia del mio cuore
programme.desc: Una proprietaria di un negozio di tè biologico aiuta una sensazione musicale a scrivere i testi per un nuovo album solista.

programme.title: The Clue to Love
programme.desc: L'ambiziosa Audrey Harper si reca a Hope Cove per scrivere sulla speciale ma anonima rubrica di consigli amorosi Chiedi a zia Hope, un pilastro del giornale locale della città. Incontra così l'affascinante caporedattore Morgan Cooper, che la aiuta a scoprire la vera identità della "zia Hope".

programme.title: 10 Years
programme.desc: Un gruppo di ex liceali organizza una rimpatriata a distanza di dieci anni dal diploma per scoprire che, nonostante il passare del tempo, molte cose sembrano essersi fermate ad allora.

programme.title: La ricerca del vero amore
programme.desc: Aspirante redattrice di rubriche sentimentali, Becks decide di aiutare il suo migliore amico Casey a tornare a casa alla ricerca del suo primo amore. Quando iniziano il loro viaggio per riconquistare il primo amore di Cassie, entrambi scoprono più cose l'uno dell'altro di quanto non sapessero.

programme.title: Il natale delle verità
programme.desc: Miranda si reca in una piccola città del Vermont sperando di trascorrere un Natale perfetto con la propria famiglia, da tempo disunita, ma una lettera anonima rischia di affondare i suoi piani.

programme.title: La miliardaria
programme.desc: Epifania ha ereditato da suo padre una fortuna favolosa e un consiglio sul tipo di uomo da sposare. Lei, invece, si sposa senza seguire il consiglio di suo padre, ma il matrimonio si rivela un fallimento.

programme.title: Gli ingredienti dellamore
programme.desc: Zoey noleggia un camion di cibo per partecipare a un concorso. Volano scintille tra lei e il fondatore di un ristorante, che è anche giudice del concorso. Zoey vuole vincere, ma sospetta che lui stia cercando la ricetta della sua salsa, non il suo cuore.

programme.title: Sempre nel mio cuore
programme.desc: Jenna e Charlie hanno trovato l'amore in Irlanda ma i loro sogni li hanno separati. Cinque anni dopo, si riuniscono e Jenna deve decidere a chi appartiene il suo cuore: a casa o sull'Isola di Smeraldo.

programme.title: The Californians
programme.desc: In una versione di 'Le bostoniane' di Henry James, una battaglia infuria tra due fratelli. Gavin, uno scaltro imprenditore, e sua sorella Olive, un'ambientalista risoluta. Ma una straordinaria cantante, Zoe, si interpone tra i due.

programme.title: Un Matrimonio Da Salvare
programme.desc: Billie is the charming owner of a wedding donation company. Her clients, Max and Jess, are calling the wedding off. Billie and Charlie, Max's brother, will have to work together to get this couple hitched. Maybe this time, it's time for Billie's wedding!

programme.title: Kung fu Mamma
programme.desc: Un agente segreto in pensione torna in servizio per fermare un trafficante d'armi.

programme.title: Un guaio di sorella
programme.desc: Klara deve vendere la fattoria e si rivolge alla sorella Mika, che vive nella grande città.

programme.title: Il fiume della vita
programme.desc: Un viaggio sul Danubio riapre ferite familiari e offre a Daniela la possibilità di riconciliarsi col passato.

programme.title: Kung fu Mamma
programme.desc: Un agente segreto in pensione torna in servizio per fermare un trafficante d'armi.

programme.title: Il fiume della vita
programme.desc: Un viaggio sulla Loira riaccende in un'anziana il ricordo del suo amore perduto e cambia molte vite.

programme.title: Melancholia
programme.desc: Justine arriva con il neomarito alla festa delle nozze che il cognato e la sorella Claire le hanno organizzato con un ritmato protocollo. Justine sorride molto ma dentro di sé prova un disagio profondo che la spingerà ad allontanarsi in più occasioni dai festeggiamenti provocando lo sconcerto di molti, marito compreso. Non si tratta però solo di un malessere esistenziale privato. Una grave minaccia incombe sulla Terra: il pianeta Melancholia si sta avvicinando e, benché il mondo scientifico inviti all'ottimismo, il rischio di collisione e di distruzione totale del globo terrestre è più che mai realistico.

programme.title: Briciole sul mare
programme.desc: Un anonimo pescatore pugliese viene rinvenuto sulle coste siciliane dai fratelli Salvo, promesso sposo di Maria, e Manuele, suo ex compagno. Quando Salvo fa per offrire alla donna un bracciale ritrovato in mare, si scoprirà che il gioiello le era stato donato in precedenza proprio da Manuele. Impossessatosene nuovamente, questi lo aveva poi regalato a Marta, ex amante di Salvo quindi, per vendetta, del fratello. Tornato ancora nelle sue mani, lo aveva infine venduto a un rigattiere. Le cose si complicano quando la polizia recupera il cadavere di una donna che Salvo identifica come la stessa Marta.

programme.title: Fuggiamo insieme
programme.desc: Quando una ragazza appena sposata scopre che suo marito è un nazista, lo lascia e scappa con un giornalista radiofonico che si innamora di lei mentre la segue alla ricerca di una storia su suo marito.

programme.title: Una Vita da Sogno
programme.desc: Una commedia sul gioco degli equivoci condita con una buona dose d'ironia e arti marziali. Il protagonista infatti si finge quello che non è per cercare di conquistare una bella ragazza… Ma anche lei a sua volta fa la stessa cosa. E quindi inizia una girandola di situazioni inaspettate ed esilaranti…

programme.title: Gli Italiani e le Donne
programme.desc: Il film è formato da cinque episodi: "I gatti del Colosseo": Tre amici romani organizzano finti scippi al Colosseo per poter poi, a turno, fingersi 'salvatori' di belle turiste. "La traversata di Milano". Un uomo sposato cerca di trovare in Milano un posto in cui poter stare con l'amante senza essere visto. "L'abito non fa il monaco": Un attore di fotoromanzi approfitta del costume da sacerdote per tentare di sedurre una donna in crisi coniugale. "L'auto garçonnière". Un uomo sposato, mentre si trova in un bosco con l'amante, viene derubato dell'auto e dei vestiti. "Chi la fa l'aspetti". Due venditori del mercato comunale cercano di sedurre le clienti ma le loro mogli sono in agguato.

programme.title: Fughe da fermo
programme.desc: Tratto dall'omonimo romanzo dello stesso Edoardo Nesi, il film racconta il disagio esistenziale e la mancanza di ideali di un gruppo di ragazzi che reagisce al vuoto da cui si sente circondato organizzando atti di rivolta. È solo la trasgressione a far sentire 'vivi' Fede e i suoi amici, che compiono gli atti più bizzarri con il solo scopo di dare un senso alla loro esistenza.

programme.title: La canzone più triste del mondo
programme.desc: Durante la Grande Depressione, nella cittadina di Winnipeg, una baronessa indice un concorso per trovare la canzone più triste del mondo. Musicisti da tutto il mondo accorreranno per vincere il primo premio: 25 mila dollari. Un musical grottesco e fantastico, diretto da un grande regista, purtroppo poco conosciuto in Italia: Guy Maddin.

programme.title: Tutto Ciò che Voglio
programme.desc: Wendy è Autistica, viene aiutata dalla terapia della struttura specializzata di Scottie, proteggendo la sua rigida routine quotidiana e permettendo che la ragazza coltivi la sua passione, ovvero la visione della saga televisiva Star Trek.

programme.title: Papi Chulo
programme.desc: A Los Angeles, un solitario e alienato meteorologo televisivo "assume" un migrante latinoamericano di mezza età per essere suo amico.

programme.title: 10 cose di noi
programme.desc: Sono tre anni che il telefono di una nota star hollywoodiana non squilla, tre anni che attende invano di tornare sotto i riflettori. L'occasione arriva con un film indipendente a basso budget ambientato in un supermercato. L'artista in disarmo, indeciso se accettare o meno la parte, fa un sopralluogo per osservare da vicino i comportamenti del personale e degli acquirenti. Colpito dal carattere determinato di Scarlet, una cassiera latina che occupa e "presidia" la "cassa amica" (massimo dieci pezzi), l'attore è deciso a farne una "protagonista". Trucco, costume, portamento e recitazione sono alcune delle cose che Scarlet imparerà per superare un colloquio di lavoro e la paura di non essere all'altezza della vita.

programme.title: Ricki And The Flash
programme.desc: Meryl Streep come non l'avete mai vista prima: una chitarrista/cantante hard rock. In una pellicola originale ed entusiasmante, piena di performance musicali dal vivo, diretta dal premio Oscar® Jonathan Demme e sceneggiata dal premio Oscar® Diablo Cody, Meryl Streep interpreta Ricki Rendazzo, una virtuosa della chitarra che ha compiuto un'infinità di errori perseguendo il proprio sogno di sfondare nel mondo del rock. Tornata a casa, Ricki affronta la propria famiglia e ha la possibilità di redimersi e sistemare le cose.

programme.title: The Brothers Solomon
programme.desc: I fratelli Solomon raccontano l'esilarante storia di Dean e John Solomon (Forte e Arnett). Quando vengono a sapere che l'ultimo desiderio del padre morente è di avere un nipote, i fratelli si mettono alla ricerca di qualcuno disposto a dar loro un figlio. Ma dopo aver trascorso gli anni della formazione in una località sperduta dell'artico, istruiti dal padre, le loro attitudini sociali risultano inadeguate e i loro tentativi di paternità finiscono istericamente male.

programme.title: Bottle Rocket
programme.desc: Una divertente commedia su tre amici, criminali dilettanti, che sognano una vita migliore. Anthony cerca il vero amore, Bob desidera una famiglia e Dignan vuole fare strada nel mondo del crimine. Dopo essere stato rilasciato da un ospedale psichiatrico in cui era finito a causa di un esaurimento nervoso, Anthony decide di partecipare a una rapina con Dignan e con il loro patetico vicino Bob mentre cercano di portarla a termine, ognuno di loro troverà ciò che stava cercando.

programme.title: Selvaggi in fuga
programme.desc: Ricky, un ragazzino di città, viene dato in affido a una famiglia di campagna della Nuova Zelanda. Si sente subito a casa con la nuova famiglia affidataria: la zia Bella, l'irascibile zio Hec e il cane Tupac. A seguito di un drammatico avvenimento, Ricky rischia di essere spedito in un'altra casa. Ciò spingerà il ragazzino ed Hec a fuggire nei boschi. Con la caccia all'uomo che ne consegue, i due sono costretti a mettere da parte le loro divergenze e a collaborare per sopravvivere.

programme.title: Scappo dalla città 2
programme.desc: In questo sequel, Mitch Robbins (Billy Crystal) e il fratello Glen (Jon Lovitz), la pecora nera della famiglia, trovano per caso una vecchia mappa del tesoro nella fascia del cappello del defunto Curly. Dopo aver scoperto che il padre di Curly aveva partecipato a un famoso furto ad un treno, si chiedono se la mappa nasconda davvero la chiave ad un tesoro.

programme.title: Il ras del quartiere
programme.desc: Domingo, capo di teppisti e custodi del quartiere, aiuta un uomo a cercare la figlia scappata di casa

programme.title: Sesso e volentieri
programme.desc: Dieci piccoli episodi collegati dal filo rosso del ""sesso e volentieri""

programme.title: Il marito in collegio
programme.desc: Carlotta sposa il benzinaio Camillo per l'eredità, ma lo manda in Svizzera per diventare raffinato.

programme.title: Il paramedico
programme.desc: Mario vince un'auto, ma dopo un furto da parte dei terroristi finisce in carcere.

programme.title: Totò Sexy
programme.desc: Due suonatori ambulanti finiscono in carcere per contrabbando e si rifugiano in sogni popolati da donne seducenti e atmosfere esotiche. Una commedia musicale guidata dall'ironia inconfondibile di Totò, tra gag surreali e fantasia.

programme.title: Anni difficili
programme.desc: Con Umberto Spadaro, Massimo Girotti e Ave Ninchi, Aldo Piscitello deve aderire al Partito Fascista e affrontare la guerra. Tra doveri familiari e scelte morali, cerca il coraggio di restare fedele a sé stesso in un'Italia in crisi.

programme.title: Vita da cani
programme.desc: Le vite di diversi personaggi si intrecciano in un susseguirsi di difficoltà quotidiane e situazioni comiche. Aldo Fabrizi, Gina Lollobrigida e Marcello Mastroianni sono protagonisti di una commedia che racconta le piccole disavventure della vita, con ironia e causticità.

programme.title: Quel fantasma di mio marito
programme.desc: Un uomo, ucciso in un incidente, ritorna come un "fantasma" per aiutare la sua moglie a superare il dolore della sua morte e a trovare la felicità. Una commedia che gioca su spirito e sentimenti in modo divertente e malinconico.

programme.title: In Fabric
programme.desc: Periodo di vendite invernali in un grande magazzino, dove un abito maledetto fa il passaggio da persona a persona, con conseguenze devastanti...

programme.title: Kill your friends
programme.desc: Londra, 1997. La scena musicale inglese sforna nomi che conquistano il successo mondiale quando il ventisettenne Steven Stelfox riesce a sfondare. Mosso da avidità, ambizione e da quantità disumane di droghe, Stelfox vive il suo sogno alla ricerca continua del prossimo disco di successo.

programme.title: Project A
programme.desc: Hong Kong, 1800. Mentre gli inglesi sono occupati a governare le terre, i pirati sono i padroni dei mari facendo razzie delle imbarcazioni che incontrano. Nonostante vari tentativi la Guardia Costiera non riesce a sconfiggerli.

programme.title: First Daughter
programme.desc: La figlia del presidente va al college, ma i pericoli del suo titolo la seguono.

programme.title: Interstate 60
programme.desc: Dal creatore di Ritorno al Futuro. Neil è un pittore ostacolato dal padre che vorrebbe vederlo laureato in legge. La situazione cambia all'improvviso quando incontra One Wish Grant (premio Oscar Gary Oldman), uomo in grado di esaudire ogni desiderio.

programme.title: Restiamo Amici
programme.desc: Alessandro viene improvvisamente contattato, dal Brasile, dal suo vecchio amico Gigi. In punto di morte, l'uomo ha un ultimo favore: per ereditare i tre milioni di euro che gli ha lasciato suo padre deve intestarli a suo figlio. Ma Gigi non ha eredi.

programme.title: Scambio di identità
programme.desc: Connie, nubile ed incinta, viaggia in direzione di Boston in treno ed incontra una giovane e facoltosa coppia di sposini in luna di miele, Hugh e Patricia. Durante il tragitto, il convoglio subisce un incidente grave e la ragazza finisce in ospedale.

programme.title: Gatto nero, gatto bianco
programme.desc: Un piccolo truffatore ottiene più di quanto ha contrattato per cui cerca di ripagare i suoi debiti facendo sposare suo figlio con la sorella di un fastidioso gangster.

programme.title: Amico mio frega tu che frego io
programme.desc: Jonas, scapestrato ladro che finge di essere un pastore, si barcamena tra truffe e raggiri vari nel vecchio West, rimanendo spesso vittima, a sua volta, degli imbrogli del rivale Mark. Quando sulle Montagne Rocciose viene scoperto l'oro, Jonas e Mark partecipano alla ricerca, ma tornando a casa vengono derubati da un gruppo di banditi. I due decidono di vendicarsi.

programme.title: Spara, Gringo, spara
programme.desc: Il proprietario terriero messicano Gutierrez si offre di salvare dall'impiccagione il fuorilegge latitante Chad Stark se quest'ultimo accetterà di trovare e restituire il figlio di Gutierrez, Fidel, che è scappato. Stark trova subito Fidel che si è unito a una banda di fuorilegge gestita da Charlie Doneghan, ex conoscente di Stark, che ora si fa chiamare “il Maggiore”.

programme.title: F.T.W.
programme.desc: Un uomo e una donna, in fuga dal loro passato, sono intrappolati in una rotta di collisione con il futuro. Insieme, i due sperimentano la propria visione personale del sogno americano.

programme.title: Execution
programme.desc: Avvincente western italiano. Un cacciatore di taglie, Clips, è da tempo sulle tracce di John Cooler, un anziano bandito sul cui capo pende una taglia di ventimila dollari. John è ricercato anche dal messicano Juarez e dalla sua banda, i quali vogliono impadronirsi di un carico d'oro che il vecchio bandito ha rubato alcuni anni prima all'esercito americano.

programme.title: La strage del 7º
programme.desc: Il capo Toro Seduto della tribù dei Sioux è costretto dal generale Custer, che odia gli indiani, a reagire con la violenza, dando luogo alla famosa “Ultima posizione” a Little Bighorn. Parrish, amico dei Sioux, cerca di impedire lo spargimento di sangue, ma viene deferito alla corte marziale per “collaborazione” con il nemico. Toro Seduto, tuttavia, riesce a intercedere presso il presidente Grant a favore di Parrish.

programme.title: Gli fumavano le Colt... lo chiamavano Camposanto
programme.desc: John e George McIntire, due fratelli ingenui, arrivano in una città del West senza legge per ritrovare il padre. Dopo aver picchiato un membro di una banda di estorsori, si cacciano nei guai. A salvarli interviene un misterioso pistolero vagabondo disposto ad aiutarli.

programme.title: Le quattro facce del West
programme.desc: Nel Nuovo Messico, un cowboy costringe un banchiere sotto la minaccia di una pistola a concedergli un prestito senza garanzie, in cambio di una cambiale, ma lo sceriffo e la sua posse lo inseguono.

programme.title: Le colline blu
programme.desc: Tre cowboy, scambiati per membri di una banda di fuorilegge, sono implacabilmente inseguiti da una squadra.

programme.title: Era Sam Wallash!... lo chiamavano... E Così Sia
programme.desc: Un bandito spietato uccide il proprietario di una taverna e, casualmente, anche il fratello di Sam Wallbush. Testimone degli omicidi, Sam giura vendetta e parte in cerca del colpevole, pronto a versare sangue per ottenere giustizia.

programme.title: Ip Man: Kung Fu Master
programme.desc: Decenni prima che diventasse il famoso insegnante di Bruce Lee, il giovane Ip Man era un capitano della polizia.

programme.desc: Dopo aver sciolto la squadra con cui aveva riportato alla luce inestimabili tesori ritenuti da tempo perduti, l'archeologo Bayi si gode un periodo di inattività a New York.

programme.title: Il pescatore di sogni
programme.desc: Il razionale dottor Jones aiuta uno sceicco a portare il salmone nello Yemen e trova l'amore.

programme.title: Walking on sunshine
programme.desc: Maddie sposa Raf, ignara che lui ami ancora sua sorella Taylor. Tra equivoci e musica, l'amore riaffiora.

programme.title: L'amore secondo Dan
programme.desc: Dan Burns, giornalista vedovo e padre di tre adolescenti, si innamora di Marie, fidanzata del fratello.

programme.title: Il sole a mezzanotte
programme.desc: Katie, costretta a vivere al buio, scopre l'amore con Charlie, il ragazzo che ammirava da lontano.

programme.title: Alien Convergence
programme.desc: Una squadra sviluppa un rivoluzionario progetto di pilotaggio neurale degli aerei da combattimento. Quando dalla NASA scoprono che qualcosa sta per entrare nell'atmosfera, il progetto viene messo a servizio per respingere l'invasione aliena che minaccia le tre più grandi città del Pianeta.

programme.title: The Last Man
programme.desc: Kurt è un veterano di guerra che rientra dal fronte e trova solo miseria. Sempre più vittima delle sue allucinazioni, si rifugia nei sermoni del profeta di strada Noe e inizia a fortificare la propria casa e il bunker sotterraneo.

programme.title: Termination Point
programme.desc: L'agente Caleb Smith deve recuperare un'arma che permette di viaggiare nel tempo, rubata dallo scienziato Daniel Winter. Winter non vuole che questa tecnologia possa finire nelle mani sbagliate e rischierà tutto per evitare che l'arma venga usata contro il mondo intero.

programme.title: Alone
programme.desc: Jessica è da poco rimasta vedova. In fuga dalla città nel disperato tentativo di superare il dolore, viene rapita e segregata da un uomo misterioso. La fuga dalle grinfie del sequestratore la porterà nel cuore della natura selvaggia del Pacifico nord-occidentale.

programme.title: It Came From Outer Space
programme.desc: A spaceship from another world crashes in the Arizona desert and only an amateur stargazer and a schoolteacher suspect alien influence when the local townsfolk begin to act strangely.

programme.title: The Binding
programme.desc: A young woman's faith is put to the ultimate test when she is forced to uncover the truth behind her husband's horrific visions.

programme.title: Starry Eyes AKA Occhi stellati
programme.desc: Determinata a diventare un'attrice di Hollywood, Sarah Walker, dopo una serie di strani provini, viene scelta come protagonista di un nuovo film prodotto da una misteriosa societa di produzione. L'opportunita ben presto avra conseguenze bizzarre che la trasformeranno sia mentalmente che fisicamente in qualcosa di bellissimo e al contempo terrificante.

programme.title: The Body Tree
programme.desc: When a group of Americans travel to Russian Siberia to honor the memory of their murdered friend, they uncover a plot that threatens all their lives

programme.title: Subspecies III: Sete di sangue
programme.desc: Terzo capitolo della saga di film horror Subspecies, diretta dal grande maestro del genere Ted Nicolau. Ancora in balia del malvagio Radu, Michelle anela ad imparare le abilità del vampiro. Nel frattempo, sua sorella Becky cerca di liberarla dalle sue malvagie grinfie e ,questa volta, non sarà sola nella difficile impresa

programme.title: Subspecies 4
programme.desc: La vampira Michelle Morgan è riuscita a fuggire dalla stretta del suo padrone, il sanguinario e malvagio Radu. Trovata e salvata da una donna chiamata Ana, viene portata in ospedale ma Radu è già diretto a Bucarest per riprendere il controllo della giovane vampira. Diretto dal maestro dell'horror Ted Nicolaou.

programme.title: Killjoy 3
programme.desc: Quattro studenti universitari in vacanza si imbattono nel clown demoniaco Killjoy. E Killjoy questa volta non è da solo: ha allevato altri 3 clown demoniaci: Punchy, Freakshow e Batty Boop. Uno specchio misterioso trasporta gli studenti e i demoni nel regno demoniaco di Killjoy, dove gli studenti devono superare prove diaboliche!

programme.title: Mega Shark vs. Mecha Sharks
programme.desc: Quando l'enorme squalo preistorico Mega Shark fa il suo terrificante ritorno, il governo americano, per provare a fermarlo, decide di ricorrere alla sua arma top-secret: il Mecha Shark, uno squalo altamente tecnologico e armato fino ai denti.

programme.title: Dollman Vs Demonic Toys
programme.desc: Innocui di giorno e letali di notte, un gruppo di infernali giocattoli, generati da un demone alla ricerca di un corpo da abitare, agisce per un solo scopo: uccidere. L'agente speciale Brick Bardo (Dollman) si allea con la poliziotta Judith Grey per liberare l'infermiera Ginger, che è tenuta prigioniera da Babyface, mente pensante della banda di giocattoli assassini. Diretto dal maestro Charles Band.

programme.title: Occupation

programme.title: Godsend

programme.title: La vedova Winchester
programme.desc: Una casa infinita, spiriti inquieti e un'ereditiera ossessionata dalla colpa e dal passato.

programme.title: A.I.Rising
programme.desc: Nel 2148, un cosmonauta si innamora dell'androide compagna nel viaggio verso Alfa Centauri.

programme.title: La Morte di Pietra
